_: S3 lô B (#567): 6 thú võ hồn + 2 dung hợp (Hạo Thiên Nhu Cốt, U Minh Bạch Hổ), cùng công thức S2. `d` gửi PixelLab /v2/vfx (lite); palette hậu kỳ [viền, tối, chủ, nhấn, sáng]. Chạy: node tools/assets/skill-vfx/run.mjs --spec lo-b.json --out <nháp>
common: Pixel art VFX for an isometric RPG skill, 3/4 top-down view, transparent background, no character, no text, dark outline, limited palette, white-hot core, centered.

um.theme: Violet panther shadow magic, three-claw scratch marks, dark smoke wisps, glowing eyes, colors violet #b06bff, deep purple #3e2266, white.

nc.theme: Soft pink rabbit magic, whip-like long ears, round puffs, white fur tufts, colors pink #ffc2e2, rose #c86a9a, white.

km.theme: Golden eagle-cat lightning magic, golden feathers wrapped in electricity, colors gold #ffd54a, brown #7a5a12, pale yellow, white.

yh.theme: Pink fox charm magic, three fox tails, heart shapes, flower petals, colors pink #ff9ad5, plum #7a2a5a, pale pink, white.

lh.theme: Fiery wolf magic, flame wolf head and fangs, fire claw marks, embers, grey smoke, colors orange #ff7a3a, amber #ffb347, dark grey.

bh.theme: White tiger magic, black tiger stripes, golden tiger eyes, paw prints, shockwave, colors white, silver, black #3a3a4c, gold accents.

hn.theme: Fusion of black war hammer and soft pink rabbit: grey cracked ground and flying rocks with pink whip arcs and white fur puffs, colors grey #9aa0b4, pink #ffc2e2.

ub.theme: Fusion of white tiger and violet panther: white-gold tiger paw shockwave, violet claw slashes, striped violet-white tiger shadow, colors white #f2f2f6, violet #b06bff.
